summary: The open AI model repository and developer inference ecosystem in 2026 is anchored by Hugging Face, which hosts over two million models but remains highly concentrated — the top 200 models account for roughly 49.6% of all downloads while about half of all models have fewer than 200 total downloads. Around this central hub, a layer of developer-facing inference APIs (Together AI, Fireworks AI, SiliconFlow, Replicate, DeepInfra, OpenRouter) competes on cost, latency, and OpenAI-compatible interfaces, while local-first tools like Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM handle on-device and self-hosted serving. Model families such as Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral drive most download volume, with DeepSeek overtaking Mistral in cumulative Hugging Face downloads in January 2026.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open model hub and community platform for hosting, sharing, discovering, and serving AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus an Inference Providers tier that routes to third-party serving backends.
platforms.model_count: ~2 million+ models (plus hundreds of thousands of datasets and Spaces)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and hosting; Pro at ~$9/month; Team/Enterprise plans; pay-as-you-go/credit-based Inference Endpoints and Inference Providers (routed, usage-based) pricing
features: Largest model, dataset, and Spaces catalog
Inference Providers tier routing to Together, Fireworks, and others
Git-based model versioning and model cards
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who want the broadest selection of open models/datasets, experimentation, and a one-stop hub for discovery and deployment

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first tool for running open LLMs on your own machine (desktop/server) with a simple CLI and local API, bundling model weights, quantization, and runtime.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models in its library (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, etc.); can import custom GGUF models
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source (you provide your own hardware); no per-token cost
features: One-command local model pull and run
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists who want private, offline, local inference on laptops or workstations without cloud costs

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A serverless, pay-per-second API for running open-source models (LLMs, image, audio, video) packaged as containers, with the simplest path from model to hosted API.
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute by hardware tier (no idle cost); custom deployments billed by GPU-time
features: Cog framework for packaging custom models
Supports LLMs, diffusion/image, audio, and video models
Easy model sharing and public playground
platforms.best_for: App developers and startups who want to ship AI features fast via a simple API without managing GPU infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A developer-facing inference and fine-tuning cloud focused on low-cost, high-throughput serving of open LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, and more) available for inference
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-token pricing (among the lowest-cost for open LLM inference); dedicated endpoints and fine-tuning billed separately
features: Broad open-model catalog including latest releases
platforms.best_for: Developers and teams seeking the lowest-cost, scalable open-LLM inference with an easy migration path from OpenAI

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform optimized for fast, low-latency serving of open LLMs and multimodal models with an OpenAI-compatible API.
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-token pricing; dedicated/on-demand deployments and fine-tuning available
features: Function calling and structured output support
platforms.best_for: Production applications needing fast, reliable, and performant open-model inference at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An all-in-one, value-focused platform for both hosting and high-performance inference of open AI models, noted for fast inference and cost-efficiency.
platforms.model_count: Dozens to hundreds of open models (LLMs, image, audio) across its serving catalog
platforms.pricing: Competitive usage-based/per-token pricing positioned as best-value; free credits/tiers for evaluation
features: Support for LLM, image, and audio models
platforms.best_for: Cost-conscious organizations and developers wanting strong value through combined hosting and fast inference

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: A low-cost inference API for running popular open-source LLMs and other models on managed GPU infrastructure with simple per-token billing.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, embeddings, image models)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-use with very competitive rates; no upfront commitment
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting cheap, no-frills open-model inference via a simple API

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/aggregator that routes requests across many model providers (both open and proprietary) through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from dozens of providers routed through one API
platforms.pricing: Pass-through per-token pricing from underlying providers plus a small routing fee; unified billing and credits
features: Single unified API across many providers
Automatic routing, fallback, and price/latency comparison
Access to both open and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want one integration point to access and compare many models/providers without managing multiple accounts

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: A Python-first serverless GPU compute platform for deploying custom models, inference endpoints, batch jobs, and ML pipelines with full code-level control.
platforms.model_count: Unbounded — you deploy any model/code; not a fixed catalog
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second serverless GPU/CPU compute by resource tier; generous free credits for getting started
features: Full control over environment and custom models
Supports inference, fine-tuning, and batch jobs
Integrates easily into existing Python workflows
platforms.best_for: ML engineers and teams who want full control to deploy custom models and pipelines as serverless GPU code

platforms.name: Baseten
platforms.purpose: A production-focused platform for deploying, serving, and scaling ML models with managed autoscaling GPU infrastructure (built around the Truss packaging framework).
platforms.model_count: Any custom or open model you package; curated model library of popular open LLMs
platforms.pricing: Usage-based compute billing by GPU-minute with autoscaling; enterprise plans available
features: Dedicated deployments for open and custom models
platforms.best_for: Teams putting custom or open models into production who need reliable, scalable managed serving

platforms.name: vLLM
platforms.purpose: An open-source, high-throughput inference and serving engine for self-hosting LLMs on your own GPUs, widely used as the backend for many commercial inference providers.
platforms.model_count: Supports most Hugging Face transformer architectures (thousands of compatible models)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source (you provide the GPU hardware/cloud)
features: Tensor and pipeline parallelism for large models
Foundation of many hosted inference stacks
platforms.best_for: Infrastructure and platform teams self-hosting high-performance LLM inference on their own GPUs

platforms.name: RunPod
platforms.purpose: A GPU cloud offering raw GPU rental and serverless endpoints for training, fine-tuning, and inference of any model at low cost.
platforms.model_count: Any model you deploy; not a fixed catalog (community templates available)
platforms.pricing: Per-hour/per-second GPU rental (community and secure cloud tiers) plus serverless per-second billing
features: Wide range of GPU types and regions
Good for training, fine-tuning, and inference
platforms.best_for: Developers and researchers wanting cheap, flexible GPU compute for custom workloads

platforms.name: LM Studio
platforms.purpose: A desktop application for discovering, downloading, and running open LLMs locally with a GUI and a local OpenAI-compatible server.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of GGUF models accessible via its in-app Hugging Face browser
platforms.pricing: Free for personal use (runs on your own hardware)
features: User-friendly desktop GUI for local models
platforms.best_for: Non-CLI users and developers who want an easy graphical way to run and test LLMs locally
